jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Us:

Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home.

We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us.

About the Role:

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to help us accelerate how homes get built.

This is a broad, high-leverage role for a product manager who wants surface area. You will own critical parts of our platform end-to-end - the systems that price a home, schedule a build, manage cost and margin, coordinate trade partners, and give our teams the information they need to make faster, better decisions. Where you focus will evolve with the business, and you will be trusted to pick up and own new squads as our priorities shift.

The through-line is speed. Every week we take off a build cycle, every dollar of variance we catch early, and every decision we can automate compounds across every home we build. You will be measured on real operational outcomes - cycle time, cost accuracy, margin, throughput, adoption - not on shipping features.

Much of this work runs on genuinely complex data: cost structures, budgets and actuals, change orders, draw schedules, vendor pricing, and multi-month probabilistic schedules. We need the kind of PM who goes into the data personally, notices when a number does not reconcile, and cares about getting it exactly right - because our operators and our financials depend on it.

AI is not a separate track here - it is deeply integrated into the platform, and we expect it to be part of how every new feature gets designed. The default question on any problem is not “what screen does the user need?” but “how much of this can the system decide, predict, draft, or eliminate outright?” We want a PM who reaches for LLMs, agents, and applied ML as first-class primitives in the product, holds a clear view of where they genuinely outperform deterministic logic, and is equally clear-eyed about where they do not belong.

What You'll Do:

  • Own a portfolio end-to-end. Set strategy, define the roadmap, and drive execution from concept through rollout and adoption for the squads you own.

  • Go where the leverage is. Take on new squads and problem spaces as the business needs them, ramping quickly on unfamiliar domains without waiting for a handoff document.

  • Make the numbers trustworthy. Build products on top of complex financial and operational data - budgets, actuals, cost structures, schedules, vendor pricing - with the rigor that data demands.

  • Build AI into every feature. Treat AI as a default design consideration rather than a special project - look at each workflow and ask what the system can predict, decide, draft, or remove entirely, then ship it with real evaluation and quality frameworks behind it.

  • Define product with precision. Write clear, actionable requirements. Think through edge cases before engineering finds them. Prioritize on impact, effort, and long-term value.

  • Measure what matters. Define success metrics up front, instrument them, and run experiments to systematically improve cycle time, cost accuracy, and adoption.

  • Drive across functions. Operate independently across Construction Operations, Finance, Sales, Design, and Engineering, moving initiatives forward without heavy process.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a complex, technical product.

  • Exceptional analytical rigor and comfort with messy, high-stakes data. You write your own queries, build your own models, and reconcile numbers yourself rather than waiting on someone else.

  • Experience with financial or operational data products - cost, pricing, margin, budgeting, forecasting, supply chain, scheduling, or similar - where accuracy is non-negotiable.

  • Genuine detail orientation. You catch the discrepancy nobody else noticed, and you sweat the edge cases that determine whether a workflow actually holds up in production.

  • A metrics-driven operating style: you define success quantitatively, instrument it, and hold yourself to it.

  • Strong technical fluency - comfortable operating alongside engineers and ML teams as peers, reasoning through system tradeoffs, and reading evaluations.

  • An AI-first instinct in how you design product. You look at a workflow and see what the system could decide or automate, not just what interface a person needs - and you can tell the difference between a problem AI genuinely solves and one where it adds risk without adding value.

  • Breadth and adaptability: a track record of owning multiple product areas, or stepping into new domains and getting productive fast.

  • 0 to 1 product building - hands-on experience taking a product from concept through launch to real-world adoption.

  • Exceptional communication skills, and the ability to translate between operators, technical teams, and executive leadership.

  • A self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and drives outcomes cross-functionally without a playbook.

  • Interest in construction and the built environment is a plus. No prior industry experience required, but an expectation to learn the domain rapidly.

Our Commitment:

We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. To apply, please submit an application with your resume on the Career’s page.

Homebound is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Homebound considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our Compensation Philosophy:

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Please note that the salary range displayed on each job posting may vary by state. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that each job posting includes a general description of any other compensation offered for the position in addition to the salary range displayed on the job posting. You can find information about our benefits here.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - DIFM
jobs.jd_full:
Taxwell helps everyday Americans get every tax advantage they deserve by finding credits and deductions they never even knew existed. Our tax preparation software offers easy guidance and ensures your maximum tax refund. We strive to build a team of like-minded experts in both tax and technology who align with our brand purpose, are advocates for our customers and have a fresh, non-traditional approach to the tax industry.

Taxwell is hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy, 0→1 innovation, and execution for Drake, our professional desktop and emerging cloud-based tax, solutions used by thousands of tax firms.

This role owns the product roadmap, annual tax season delivery, and long-term evolution of the professional tax portals and document import platform. You will focus on improving preparer productivity, ensuring compliance with federal and state tax law changes, and maintaining a high performance, reliable experience during peak season.

We are looking for a strong product leader who understands complex software, values operational excellence, and can balance innovation with stability in a mission critical environment. In addition, this role will identify and build new product capabilities from ideation through launch, helping shape the future of our cloud-based tax ecosystem.

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Define and own the product vision and roadmap, including both platform evolution and new product innovation
  • Balance innovation with platform stability and reliability, in a mission critical environment
  • Identify opportunities to improve core workflows, customer value, and new product offerings
  • Evaluate opportunities using customer insights, data, and market analysis

Annual Tax Season Delivery

  • Lead planning and execution of annual tax law updates
  • Partner with compliance and tax content teams to implement federal and state changes accurately and on time
  • Prioritize features and enhancements within fixed regulatory deadlines
  • Ensure product readiness and performance during peak tax season

Customer Experience and Execution

  • Use customer insights and data to drive measurable improvements
  • Partner with engineering on performance, architecture, and technical priorities
  • Collaborate with support, sales, and go to market teams
  • Communicate priorities and trade offs clearly to stakeholders and leadership

Innovation & New Product Development

  • Identify and validate new product opportunities through customer discovery, data, and market trends
  • Lead initiatives from ideation → validation → MVP → launch → early scale
  • Rapidly test and iterate using experiments and customer feedback
  • Explore opportunities to apply AI, automation, and modern cloud capabilities

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience building or scaling cloud-based / SaaS products
  • Experience in tax, accounting, fintech, or compliance driven products is a plus
  • Proven ability to manage complex release cycles under tight deadlines
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Strong ability to balance innovation with operational excellence
  • Excellent communication and cross functional leadership skills
  • High attention to detail and execution

If you are passionate about building innovative, high impact software for professional users and want to shape the future of Drake Software, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Client Delivery Manager - Revenue Cycle (REMOTE)
jobs.jd_full:
EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified E360 RCM™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M+ processed claims, and expert human-in-the-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out-of-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book’s #1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years.

Position Summary

The Client Delivery Manager is a client-facing role responsible for independently managing operational alignment, performance consulting, and issue resolution for assigned client accounts. The Client Delivery Manager serves as a trusted operational advisor to clients, translating complex operational data into clear insights, recommendations, and action-oriented narratives. This role partners closely with Revenue Services, Client Success, Implementation, and other internal teams to drive alignment across the client lifecycle, while escalating strategically to the Client Alignment Director as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently own operational alignment for assigned client accounts
  • Develop a deep working knowledge of client contracts, SLAs, service-line scope, workflows, and operational dependencies
  • Translate operational performance data into meaningful narratives that clearly articulate drivers, risks, and opportunities
  • Proactively identify trends, risks, and misalignment across the client lifecycle and recommend corrective actions
  • Partner with clients to align operational expectations with internal capabilities and constraints
  • Monitor operational performance indicators and inventory health to identify emerging issues or deviations
  • Lead structured root cause analysis efforts in partnership with Revenue Services and other internal teams
  • Develop clear, outcome-oriented action plans with defined ownership, sequencing, and follow-up
  • Track action plan progress and validate effectiveness over time
  • Exercise sound judgment in determining when and how to escalate issues, providing clear context, analysis, and recommended paths forward
  • Own preparation and facilitation of monthly operational reviews and recurring client touchpoints
  • Develop agendas, reporting narratives, and discussion materials tailored to client priorities
  • Lead client discussions with confidence, professionalism, and consultative presence
  • Document meeting outcomes, decisions, and action items, ensuring clear follow-through
  • Serve as a consistent and reliable operational presence for assigned client accounts
  • Partner closely with Revenue Services leadership and operational teams to understand performance drivers and constraints
  • Coordinate with Client Success, Implementation, Product, and Technology teams to support alignment across the client lifecycle
  • Lead internal account reviews and ensure internal stakeholders are aligned on priorities, risks, and commitments
  • Advocate for client needs while balancing enterprise standards and scalability
  • Ensure accurate and timely documentation of client interactions, escalations, and decisions in CRM and internal systems
  • Apply Client Alignment methodologies and standards consistently across assigned accounts
  • Identify recurring themes, systemic issues, or improvement opportunities across the client portfolio
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives, workflow refinement, and documentation updates
  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer for new team members as needed
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Operations, or a related field required
  • 3–5 years of experience in healthcare operations, revenue cycle, client-facing roles, or related environments
  • Foundational understanding of operational workflows, data interpretation, and client support models
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey operational information clearly
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage client relationships and operational discussions
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable insight
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including client-facing presentation experience
  • Proven ability to influence without authority in cross-functional environments
  • Timely and regular attendance
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Special Considerations and Prerequisites

jobs.title: Program Manager, Strategy & Operations (Remote)
jobs.jd_full:
We are seeking a Program Manager, Strategy & Operations to join the Office of the President. In this role, you will serve as the quarterback for our Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), driving the disciplined execution and operational excellence required to meet Aledade’s strategic priorities.

As a strategic operator and internal consultant, you will partner with leaders across the organization to turn high-level vision into actionable outcomes. You will be instrumental in bridging the gap between strategy and execution—fostering cross-functional collaboration, proactively addressing roadblocks, and ensuring our teams remain aligned with our most ambitious goals.

This is a unique opportunity to gain direct exposure to senior leadership while developing your operational toolkit. By ensuring our business objectives are translated into successful results, you will contribute directly to Aledade’s mission of empowering independent primary care.

We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

Primary Duties:

Performance Management:

  • Drive Accountability: Own the end-to-end performance management of AOP Objectives and Key Results, ensuring owners are empowered and accountable for delivering on their targets.
  • Maintain Operational Tempo: Act as the heartbeat of the AOP, ensuring consistent progress through proactive follow-ups, closing feedback loops, and keeping cross-functional workstreams on schedule.
  • Surface & Mitigate Risk: Early-identify systemic risks or operational blockers to OKR success; partner with teams to develop mitigation strategies and escalate critical issues to leadership to ensure a path forward.

Strategic & Annual Planning:

  • Lead Planning Cycles: Facilitate the departmental annual planning process and mid-year (2H) adjustments, ensuring departmental goals remain ambitious yet realistic.
  • Continue to Build the Playbook: Continuously refine and document the AOP Playbook at Aledade, codifying best practices to make each planning cycle more efficient and predictable than the last.
  • QBR Preparation: Partner with department Ops Leads to prepare high-quality materials and narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), ensuring a data-driven story of progress and challenges.

Cross-Functional Orchestration & Alignment:

  • Stakeholder Management: Build deep, trust-based relationships across the organization to facilitate honest discussions regarding progress, resource gaps, and cross-departmental dependencies.
  • Early Alignment Integration: Act as the “glue” between departments, ensuring that initiatives have early and consistent alignment with Analytics, Field, and Product stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Bridge: Serve as the central point of contact to ensure that changes in one department’s roadmap are communicated and reconciled with the broader AOP.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years progressive experience in operations, strategy, program management or consulting
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities:

  • Master’s degree preferred
  • Proven ability to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, including senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing projects, tracking performance, and driving execution in a complex environment.

Ability to think critically, identify issues, and develop actionable strategic solutions.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to diverse audiences and influence stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.

Physical Requirements:

  • Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we’ve become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you’re eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you’ve come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles

Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)

Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays

12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents

Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service

Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program

401(k) with up to 4% match

Stock options

And much more!

jobs.title: Senior Project & Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
We’re transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart’s Customer Experience & Operations organization is at the heart of how we support the millions of customers, shoppers, and partners who rely on our platform every day. Within that organization, the CX Technology Programs team is responsible for driving the development and deployment of technology solutions that meaningfully improve the support experience at scale.

We are looking for a CX Technology Program Manager to join a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of automation, operations, and product execution. This role sits within a team of three — two individual contributors and a people manager — and will play a critical role in bringing structure, coordination, and momentum to an ambitious chatbot automation program. With 14 automations currently in active development across Shopper and Customer support programs and significant monthly cost savings on the line, this is a role where your work will have immediate, measurable business impact. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, are energized by complexity, and know how to drive programs forward without waiting for perfect conditions, this role is for you.

About the Job

  • Own end-to-end planning and coordination for a portfolio of chatbot automation initiatives spanning both Shopper and Customer support programs, ensuring timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders are aligned across concurrent workstreams.
  • Drive program execution in an environment where priorities shift and the roadmap evolves — you’ll be the connective tissue between technical teams, operations, and leadership, keeping work moving and risks visible.
  • Build and maintain the operational infrastructure for the CX Technology Programs team, including program tracking, status reporting, and cross-functional communication rhythms that give stakeholders confidence in the work underway.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and CX operations teams to scope, sequence, and launch automation solutions, translating business goals into clear plans with defined milestones and accountability.
  • Identify gaps, surface blockers early, and propose solutions — this team is currently under-resourced on the planning and coordination side, and you will be stepping in to immediately add structure and move critical work forward.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, or operations program management, ideally within a technology, e-commerce, or customer experience organization.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent programs with cross-functional stakeholders, including the ability to build and maintain program plans, track dependencies, and communicate status clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working on or alongside automation, AI, or chatbot technology programs, with a working understanding of how these solutions are scoped, built, and deployed in an operational context.
  • Proficiency with project and program management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or similar) and comfort using data to track progress and communicate impact.
  • Proven ability to operate independently and create structure in ambiguous environments, including stepping into under-resourced programs and quickly establishing clarity and momentum.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.

About the Product Team

At Emplifi, our mission is to transform how digital marketing—especially on social—is done, and how consumers connect with brands in the 21st century.

Our Product team sits at the heart of this mission. We build and evolve a data-driven SaaS platform that helps global enterprises market smarter. By bridging customer needs, business goals, and technical innovation, we break down silos, foster collaboration, and use insights to guide smart, impactful decisions.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape the future of Emplifi’s Data Insights capabilities — a core product area that enables brands to understand conversations, uncover emerging topics, and act on market signals that matter most.

This is about building intelligence that helps brands understand what people care about, how perceptions evolve, and where opportunities arise across digital channels. You’ll be leading a product area that helps marketers and strategists collect the right data and turn them into actionable insight—at scale.

You’ll own the roadmap, vision, and execution for this strategic capability, partnering closely with design, engineering, data science, and go-to-market teams to create powerful, intuitive experiences for enterprise users. This includes managing integrations with external data providers to ensure scalable, high-quality access to insights.

This position is remote/hybrid from within the Czech Republic, the UK, France, or Germany.

Why This Role Matters

In today’s world, tracking discourse, sentiment, and context across digital sources gives brands a competitive edge. Organizations that move fast to uncover trends, surface risks, and respond to emergent feedback win. You’ll lead a product at the intersection of data, AI, and strategy helping the world’s leading brands stay in tune with conversations, perceptions, and signals that shape their markets.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about turning complex, unstructured data into clear insight and action
  • Understands how enterprise marketers, analysts, and strategists use insights to guide decisions
  • Can translate business challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions powered by AI and analytics
  • Thrives in a space where technology, storytelling, and customer empathy meet

What You’ll Do Here

  • Own the vision and roadmap for one of the Data Insights product line — setting direction based on customer needs, market dynamics, and company goals
  • Drive product discovery - talking to customers (brands and retailers), observing behavior, synthesizing data, and identifying unmet needs and opportunities
  • Translate ideas into execution - write clear requirements, work with design and engineering, and iterate fast to deliver impactful, high-quality solutions
  • Be a market expert - understand the competitive landscape and adjacent categories, monitor trends in ecommerce and AI, and translate them into product strategy
  • Manage data partnerships and integrations- oversee connections with third-party data providers and APIs, ensuring consistent, reliable data access, evaluate vendor performance, react quickly to API or data schema changes, and balance product impact against integration costs
  • Partner cross-functionally - collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Leadership to position the product for success across the customer lifecycle
  • Measure what matters - define success metrics, analyze outcomes, and refine based on learnings to ensure continuous improvement and customer value

What You’ll Bring to Us

  • 3+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally in B2B SaaS
  • Track record of product impact – You’ve successfully led products through key stages of their lifecycle, whether taking over complex existing solutions or driving new launches, and can demonstrate how you improved outcomes and measured results
  • Deep familiarity with AI in practice — you actively use AI tools to enhance your workflow and have experience defining, delivering, and iterating on AI-powered features that create tangible value for users
  • High autonomy & maturity – You’re ready to own a product stream within your first 90 days, defining strategy, uncovering new problems, and driving delivery without hand-holding
  • Global mindset – Comfortable collaborating with colleagues and customers across time zones and cultures
  • Agile mindset – Experienced in iterative releases, and data-driven optimisation
  • Technical fluency & AI awareness – You can talk architecture with engineers, understand how complex distributed systems fit together, and spot opportunities to apply the latest AI/ML advances to solve customer problems
  • Fluent, persuasive communicator – You write, present, and negotiate confidently in English while actively listening, distilling insights, persuading stakeholders, and selling product value
  • Proactive problem-solver – You spot issues, rally the right people, and deliver solutions, no waiting for task lists

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with managing products that rely on external or third-party data sources, comfortable analyzing ROI, negotiating data costs, and adapting quickly to changes in API availability or pricing
  • Experience with analytics, data visualization, or insight-generation tools
  • Background in social media, audience research, or digital strategy
  • Passion for empowering organizations to make smarter, faster, data-driven decisions

What We Offer

  • International and fast-paced environment
  • Chance to work with the world’s biggest brands at the CX tech leader
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Sick Days & Community Service Days
  • Multisport card
  • Maternity and Parental Benefit
  • Agile and open-minded culture, with high levels of trust and flexibility
  • Opportunity for professional growth and development
  • Possibility to learn new and cutting-edge technologies, in an environment that encourages new ideas
  • AI-first workplace, with access to leading AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more), empowering you to work smarter, innovate faster, and build AI skills for the future

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Marketplace Supply
jobs.jd_full:
About ShiftKey

ShiftKey is a platform that is disrupting the way healthcare facilities find licensed and certified professionals to fill available shifts. Leveraging marketplace dynamics and deep industry knowledge, the company is playing a vital role in mitigating America’s healthcare staffing shortages, enabling direct connections between facilities and healthcare professionals. By offering the opportunity to work as much or as little as they choose and putting the power back into the hands of healthcare workers, ShiftKey is bringing more licensed professionals back into the workforce, a solution that is solving a major crisis in healthcare. For more information, visit www.ShiftKey.com.

The role

ShiftKey connects healthcare professionals with facilities across diverse care settings, and our professional experience - from the first shift someone picks up to whether they’re still picking up shifts three years later - is what keeps that marketplace healthy. Our Product Team operates in an augmented model - you will direct what we are building toward and our non-negotiables, while our delivery partners direct how it gets built.

Professionals who pick up shifts on ShiftKey have options - other platforms, direct facility work, leaving staffing entirely. This role owns the experience that makes ShiftKey the one they stick with: finding shifts, getting placed, seeing what they earn and why, building a reputation, and coming back. You’ll own Professional Lifetime Value as the metric that tells you whether it’s working, and you’ll partner with the PM who owns the facility side to keep the marketplace healthy on both ends.

Where you’ll work

This is a fully remote position based in the United States. You should be comfortable working asynchronously and partnering with teammates in different time zones.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the professional’s experience end to end: discovery, placement, and what keeps them coming back.

  • Define and own Professional Lifetime Value, reporting on it up to leadership.

  • Build the retention strategy that keeps professionals active for years, not just their first shift.

  • Design how professionals build reputation and get discovered by facilities.

  • Make earnings clear - what they make, why, and how to make it better.

What you’ll need

  • 7-9 years in product management, with meaningful time on the supply side of a marketplace or platform.

  • Experience solving for engagement, not just availability, in a marketplace or platform.

  • Comfort connecting product decisions to unit economics and talking through them with finance.

  • Sharp data instincts - you instrument before you build, and can diagnose retention vs. discovery problems.

  • A strong track record partnering across team boundaries you don’t fully control.

Perks of working for ShiftKey

  • Inclusive and collaborative work environment where all voices are valued.

  • Hybrid-friendly office spaces designed to be fun and engaging.

  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.

  • Benefits begin on your first day.

  • Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including flexible floating holidays.

  • 100% 401(k) employer match up to 6%.

  • Paid parental leave.

  • Wellness support, including access to mental health resources.

#LI-Remote

Our Commitment to Diversity

ShiftKey is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to embracing diverse and individual perspectives shaping our culture and contributing to the solutions that transform the world. We actively work to create an inclusive environment for employees to thrive.

EEO Statement

ShiftKey does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable law. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.  ShiftKey is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with a mental or physical disability, please contact: accommodations@shiftkey.com

jobs.jd_full:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

The Role

DEPT® is seeking a hybrid Technical Product & Program Manager (TPM) to drive the day-to-day execution of a high-velocity AI-enablement engineering partnership program for a premier global enterprise client. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of product strategy and agile delivery, bridging the gap between localized business stakeholders and a dedicated team of embedded engineers.

You will act as the shared strategic lead across two distinct enterprise business units, directly managing the project workflow for a pod of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE). Partnering closely with the overarching Group Director, Program Management and the Senior Engineering Lead, you will translate raw marketer ideation and low-code prototypes into strict technical sprints, unblock development queues, and actively manage the day-to-day workflow within the client’s proprietary task and issue-tracking ecosystems.

What you’ll do

Product translation & requirements gathering

  • Translate the vision: Partner directly with marketing and business stakeholders to evaluate their custom AI concepts and “vibe-coded” prototypes. Translate these functional mockups into rigorous, actionable technical requirements and user stories for your engineering pod.
  • Help define the MVP: Act as the product owner for your specific business units, helping stakeholders prioritize features, define and document business logic, and help determine what is required for a rapid prototype versus a full production build.

Agile execution & workflow management

  • Run your program engine: Own the day-to-day sprint management and task execution for your dedicated pod of embedded engineers.
  • Master the internal ecosystem: Actively manage and maintain project momentum within the client’s complex, proprietary enterprise task-flow and bug-tracking systems. You will ensure every ticket is properly routed, dependencies are logged, and code-review queues are unblocked.
  • Clear the path: Proactively identify and help resolve technical dependencies - such as complex infrastructure permissions, environment setups, and data access approvals - before they slow down engineering velocity.

Cross-pollination & delivery

  • Bridge the business units: Serve as a shared resource across two distinct enterprise verticals. You will build deep subject matter expertise in both areas and proactively cross-pollinate technical learnings, ensuring that a breakthrough in one unit is leveraged by the other.
  • Ensure SLA compliance: Track and enforce service level agreements (SLAs) for different technical tracks, ensuring your engineering pod delivers rapid prototypes and safe testing environments on time and on budget.
  • Maintain architectural alignment: Work closely with the central technical governance team to ensure all localized builds meet strict enterprise architecture, data privacy, and security standards.

What you’ll bring

  • Hybrid expertise: 5+ years of experience acting as a Technical Program Manager, Technical Product Manager, or Agile Scrum Master - ideally blending the strategic “why” of product management with the executional “how” of program delivery.
  • System navigation: Deep experience operating within complex, proprietary enterprise ticketing, task, and bug-tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, or proprietary big-tech internal equivalents).
  • Technical fluency: A strong understanding of modern web application architecture, API integrations, cloud environments, and emerging AI/LLM capabilities. You do not need to write code, but you must be able to hold your own in deep technical architectural discussions with senior engineers.
  • Cross-functional agility: Proven ability to manage competing priorities across multiple distinct business units simultaneously, seamlessly context-switching between different stakeholder needs.
  • Unblocker and helper mentality: A relentless, proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks - whether they are bureaucratic approval queues or technical dependencies - and actively clearing the path for your developers.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our  benefits package:

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401k plan, plus matching
  • PTO
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Parental Leave

We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

Business Systems Operations (BSO) strengthens the operational systems that turn strategy into measurable business value. You will report to the Senior Manager, Business Systems Operations, and partner with leaders across Program Strategy and Operations, Technology Lifecycle and Governance, and Business Systems Design. You will also collaborate with teams throughout Engineering, IT, Security, Product, Finance, Legal, and other areas of the business.

This is an individual contributor role that relies on influence, facilitation, and alignment rather than direct authority.

  • Proactively address cross-program risks, bottlenecks, and resource constraints, escalating issues through the appropriate channels when needed.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Remote)
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

As a CBRE Project Management Consultant, you will be responsible for providing consulting services to an assigned market or client account to help achieve the company’s strategic business objectives.

This job is part of the Project Management function. They are responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage all areas of project management for singular real estate projects. This includes planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.
  • Work directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project. This includes the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & milestones, quality control, and risk identification.
  • Define the project delivery resources from pre-qualified lists or through the project qualification process. Conduct a standard request for proposals, complete bid evaluations, and recommend resources to clients.
  • Implement project documentation governance that is aligned with company and client requirements.
  • Ensure project data integrity and documentation is accurate, timely, and coordinated.
  • Direct the project delivery team by providing guidance and direction to achieve goals.
  • Create action plans to meet objectives, budget, and schedule. Track the progress of each project and report status and variances.
  • Demonstrate ability to identify project threats and develop risk mitigation and contingency plans. Implement action plans to reduce or eliminate project risks.
  • Apply in-depth knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish complex assignments and provide innovative solutions.
  • Coach others and share in-depth knowledge of own job discipline and broad knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
  • Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Work to build consensus and convince others to reach an agreement.
  • Impact a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities within own team and other related teams.
  • Work within broad guidelines and policies.
  • Explain difficult or sensitive information.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred with 5-8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.
  • Ability to exercise judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information.
  • Willingness to take a new perspective on existing solutions.
  • In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
  • Organizational skills with an advanced inquisitive mindset.
  • Sophisticated math skills. Ability to calculate mildly complex figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

Additional Information

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client’s needs*

The base salary range for this role is $90,000-$115,000 USD. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and www.cbre.com

jobs.title: Product Manager, Strategic Integrations - Remote
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Job Description

We would love for you to join us at Experian to help shape the future of employer services for Human Resources compliance and outsourcing. Reporting to the Senior Director of Product Management, in a remote role, we are looking for a strategic Product Manager. This individual contributor will lead product strategy for identifying and delivering a set of integration opportunities across Employer Services and the broader HR technology ecosystem. You will shape the integrations strategy for priority opportunities that expand how our products deliver, strengthen partner connectivity, and improve client value.

You will sit at the intersection of product strategy, ecosystem partnerships, data connectivity, and new solution development. You combine product management discipline with commercial curiosity, technical fluency, and execution. You can evaluate integration opportunities, develop recommendations, and translate approved priorities into scalable product plans.

  • You are a strategic thinker- Experience managing multiple simultaneous projects, and technology capabilities into a clear integrations strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes.
  • You are curious and inventive - naturally asks why, challenges legacy assumptions, looks at opportunities from different angles, and explores new combinations of capabilities that can create outsized value.
  • You are execution-oriented - create clarity, drives decisions, and follows through across complex projects from concept through market adoption.
  • You will guide agreement through persuasion rather than positional power, and know when to escalate versus when to keep working the problem through relationships.
  • You are technically fluent - understands modern integration patterns, cloud and data architectures, APIs, and data exchange models well enough to shape strategy, assess tradeoffs, and partner with technical teams.

Responsibilities include:

  • Lead product strategy development for priority integration projects within Employer Services, identifying high-value opportunities to improve connectivity, delivery, and partner-enabled growth.
  • Partner with Partnerships and Alliances to prioritize strategic integration opportunities, including embedded experiences and co-created solutions, assessing each for product viability, client value, and scalable execution.
  • Provide product strategy recommendations for where Employer Services should build, partner, integrate, or co-create, supported by customer value, business case, and execution feasibility
  • Identify opportunities to improve connectivity across priority Employer Services products, reusing capabilities where practical and supporting a more integrated client experience.
  • Shape the strategy for scalable data connections across HCM, payroll, and related source systems. This will help products to receive the data they need. Additionally, it will reduce source-system dependency and help broader product reach.
  • Assess and help develop new integration and solution concepts that emerge from partnership opportunities, with a focus on product viability, client value, and scalable execution.
  • Lead discovery and execution for priority integration opportunities, defining success measures and communicating product rationale, tradeoffs, progress, and value to partners and leadership partners.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product management or related experience creating and scaling software, platform, integration, or data products, with experience driving complex product projects.
  • Demonstrated strength in modern product management disciplines including opportunity discovery, customer and market validation, product strategy, outcome-based roadmaps, prioritization, requirements, launch, and measurement.
  • Advanced AI product fluency involves hands-on experience applying generative AI, large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and AI-enabled product practices. These practices accelerate discovery, improve decision-making, and create notable customer value. Furthermore, I am able to identify high-value AI opportunities and assess data, technology, risk, and build-versus-partner tradeoffs with technical teams.
  • Experience identifying and shaping ecosystem or partnership-led product opportunities, such as product integrations, embedded solutions, white-label models, channel partnerships, or co-build projects.
  • Experience evaluating strategic options, create structure and, build a compelling product and business case, and move complex projects from concept to measurable market outcomes.
  • You have technical fluency with modern integration and data technologies. These technologies include APIs, cloud-based architectures, data ingestion and exchange patterns, and scalable data services. Additionally, they can assess technical tradeoffs without needing to operate as an engineer.
  • Experience in HR Tech, employer services, HCM, payroll, compliance, or adjacent enterprise software ecosystems.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree.

Additional Information

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian’s culture is people first, inclusive, and purpose driven. It is multi-award-winning, including World’s Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25) and Great Place to Work™ in 26 countries, to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. We list the base pay range for this position above. Within this range, work location and additional factors such as job-related experience, and education determine individual pay. You will be also eligible for a variable pay opportunity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Benefits/Perks:

  • Great compensation package and bonus
  • Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K
  • Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office
  • Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays
  • Explore all our exciting benefits here: https://yourexperianbenefits.com/cand-index.html

Fraud Awareness - Experian’s recruitment process is conducted only through authorized channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
